inputs.text: Blue Waters’ owner says the Government collects taxes “without doing or investing in anything,” while plastic bottles continue to choke rivers and drains. Calling it an environmental tax seems like a convenient cover: the money is collected, but the cleanup never appears. It looks less like a failed system than one designed to keep collecting while the public pays twice—once in taxes and again through the damage left behind.
